description: This file defines a class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Nil which represents a 'nil' or null value in XML-RPC data types, inheriting from Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar, and includes constructor and getValue method implementations.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Nil
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC 'nil' value, returning PHP null when getValue is called.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object by setting the type to 'NIL' and value to null.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns PHP null corresponding to the XML-RPC nil value.
